name: Remotion
tagline: Make videos programmatically with React — create dynamic video content using JavaScript and React components.
description: Remotion is a framework for creating videos programmatically using React. Write video code in JavaScript/TypeScript with React components, animations, and dynamic content. Supports rendering to MP4, WebM, GIF, and other formats. Includes CLI tools, server APIs, and cloud rendering capabilities. Perfect for generating videos at scale, creating dynamic content, and automating video production workflows.
author: remotion-dev
